item.title: Vancouver FC ousted from CONCACAF Champions Cup with lopsided loss to Cruz Azul
item.description: PUEBLA CITY — Vancouver FC saw its run at the CONCACAF Champions Cup come to an end with a 5-0 loss to Cruz Azul on Thursday.

item.title: All-Star reliever Elroy Face, who saved 3 games for Pirates in 1960 World Series, dies at 97
item.description: PITTSBURGH (AP) — Elroy Face, an All-Star reliever for the Pittsburgh Pirates who saved three games in the 1960 World Series to help them upset the New York Yankees, has died. He was 97.

item.title: Holiday and Clingan boost Trail Blazers to 135-119 win over Jazz
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Jrue Holiday scored a season-high 31 points and Donovan Clingan added 23 points and 18 rebounds as the Portland Trail Blazers beat Utah 135-119 on Thursday night — hours after the Jazz lost Jaren Jackson Jr.

item.title: LeBron James becomes oldest player with triple-double in Lakers' 124-104 win over Mavericks
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — LeBron James became the oldest player in NBA history with a triple-double when he put up 28 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds in the Los Angeles Lakers' 124-104 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Thursday night.

item.title: LeBron James becomes the oldest player to have a triple-double in NBA history
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — LeBron James became the oldest player in NBA history to have a triple-double, accomplishing the feat Thursday night at 41 years and 44 days old during the Los Angeles Lakers' 124-104 victory over the Dallas Mavericks.

item.title: Tankers beware: Jazz fined $500,000, Pacers $100,000 by NBA for player participation policy breach
item.description: Utah appeared to find a loophole in the NBA's player participation policy , but the league sent a message Thursday by hitting the Jazz with a $500,000 fine.
